subject: Tool invocation & JSON-mode metering — rate card and enterprise discount proposal
messages:
From: A. Simmons <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <cto@nimbushealth.com>, legal@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:01:00 -0700
Subject: Request: baseline rate card + metering for JSON/tool invocation

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile you showed. Procurement is starting the cost analysis for a potential enterprise agreement and we need a clear baseline: 1) an up-to-date rate card for the hosted API (per-token pricing and embeddings), and 2) explicit metering details for structured output (JSON-mode) and tool/function calling — specifically whether tool invocations are charged per-token only, per-invocation, or both.

For context, our expected first-year usage (back-of-envelope): ~80M tokens/month and ~120k tool invocations/month (most invocations are short JSON payloads returning structured records). Can you provide a price breakdown and any standard enterprise discounts for 12-month commitments? Also include standard setup/onboarding fees and whether you provide committed spend credits.

Appreciate a written rate card and any short note on how metering affects cost estimates.

Best,
A. Simmons
Procurement Manager
Nimbus Health

Attachments: NIM_Rate_Request_Form.pdf (completed)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: A. Simmons <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <cto@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: baseline rate card + metering for JSON/tool invocation

Hi A.,

Thanks — appreciate the usage snapshot. I've attached our current Q3 rate card (Redwood_Ratecard_Q3_2026.xlsx) and summarized answers below to make the math easier:

- Base token pricing (hosted API, standard models): $0.004 per 1k input tokens / $0.01 per 1k output tokens.
- JSON-mode (structured output): metered purely by output tokens; there is no separate ‘field’ surcharge. If your JSON payloads are more verbose, output token counts rise accordingly.
- Tool/function calling: two components apply: (1) model token consumption (input + output tokens) and (2) a per-invocation routing fee for instrumented tool calls when we execute external tool integrations through our managed connector. Routing fee default: $0.0015 per invocation (covers secure connector throughput, retries, and tracing). If you use simple internal function calls without external connectors, we can waive the routing fee — then you're only charged token-wise.

Discounts / commitments (high level):
- Standard: 5% off list for first-year prepay / commit $100k+
- Enterprise: tiered discounts up to 20% for multi-quarter commitments (negotiated for $250k+ ARR) + reduced routing fees by 25% at higher tiers.
- Setup/onboarding: typically waived for enterprise deals > $200k ARR.

Quick ask: can you confirm the split between "connector" invocations (external integrations, webhooks, database calls) versus purely internal function/tool calls? That changes the routing fee applicability. Also let me know if you plan to pin a model family (we have different token profiles per family).

I'll loop in our commercial lead for any deeper discounting.

Best,
Dev Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Forwarding Nimbus' usage and our initial guidance. Key asks: 80M tokens/month, 120k invocations/month, ~80% connector calls. Asked for 12-month committed pricing and standard discount.

My proposal for commercial:
- Token tiering: keep list token rates but propose 15% off for a 12-month $200k commit.
- Routing fee: drop to $0.0010 per invocation for connector calls at this commit level.
- Waive onboarding fee.

Can you confirm whether we should be more aggressive on the routing fee or offer an additional committed-credit bucket for invocations (e.g., 1M included invocations then pay-as-you-go)?

— Dev

Thanks for the context — pricing thoughts below. I prefer a simple, auditable structure so their finance team can model it easily.

Proposed commercial terms (finalizable in SOW):
1) Committed spend: 12-month commit = $220,000 (annual committed spend).
   - Effective token discount: 15% off list for the committed bucket.
   - We use token consumption to draw down the commit; overage billed at list minus 10% (to avoid double-penalizing).
2) Invocation economics:
   - Include 1,000,000 connector invocations in the committed package.
   - Additional connector invocations: $0.0010 per invocation (reduced from default).
   - Internal/purely internal function calls: no per-invocation fee beyond tokens.
3) Onboarding/setup fee: waived.
4) SLA / credits: standard enterprise SLA applies; credit thresholds negotiated separately.

Rationale: including a large bucket simplifies their forecast and gives us predictability. Given their numbers (120k/mo), 1M included is ~8 months of their expected connector usage — reasonable for trial + ramp.

Next steps: Dev, please send this proposal to Nimbus along with the rate card and draft SOW template. Add HubSpot HS-4012 and propose a short 30-minute pricing call. I can approve the committed $220k if legal confirms standard terms.

— Marissa
Head of Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference

- Invocations: 1,000,000 connector invocations included; additional connector invocations at $0.0010 each.
- Routing fee reduction: effective for connector invocations; internal tool calls billed token-only.
- Onboarding/setup fee: waived.
